name: Code Recipe Foundry
actions: import a user-selected CSV or JSON recipe catalog
load the installed normalized 1,000-entry catalog explicitly
run a bounded parse-only syntax audit without executing snippets
validate recipe structure and provenance fields
group language variants without collapsing them
query reviewed recipe metadata as bounded Creation Fabric evidence without copying or executing snippets
export a normalized recipe pack and intake receipt
summary: Search and review an installed 1,000-entry code-recipe catalog, inspect parse-only syntax evidence, turn bounded CSV/JSON intakes into provenance-visible non-executable packs, and project bounded metadata-only recipe evidence for Creation Fabric without turning snippets into executable providers.
notes: The recovered bundle was independently cross-checked across JSON and CSV. It contains 937 quick recipes plus 63 visible review holds. Parse-only adapters screened 111 entries with the locally available Node, Python and Windows PowerShell parsers; 826 remain unproven and no syntax result is treated as runtime, correctness or safety proof. The Creation Fabric bridge searches metadata only, emits snippet digests rather than snippet bytes, and grants no provider, execution, promotion or CANON authority.
